stem: Which statement best reflects nutrient availability?
choices: High EC identifies every nutrient present
pH has no relationship to nutrient chemistry
A nutrient can be present in solution yet be poorly available because root-zone chemistry, water status, interactions or root health affect uptake
rationale: A nutrient can be present in solution yet be poorly available because root-zone chemistry, water status, interactions or root health affect uptake. This preserves the Course 004 measurement, root-zone, nutrition, work-order, equipment or record-quality principle being assessed.
